notes.title: System Refinements & Guidance Improvements
notes.notes:
This update focuses on enhancing player experience, performance stability, and interaction clarity across key gameplay systems:

[b]Subtle Player Guidance[/b]: Introduced light tutorial elements to improve early-game direction without compromising exploration freedom. Key actions are now better signposted through contextual interactions and environment cues.

[b]Energy Tree Interaction Enhancements[/b]: Interaction text now adapts dynamically based on tree condition (e.g., withered states) and the player's equipped tools. This ensures clearer feedback and streamlines resource harvesting.
[b]
Performance Optimization[/b]: On certain configurations, players may see a 10–20% FPS increase due to strategic removal of Nanite rendering on dense foliage assets. These are now handled via improved instancing and HLOD offloading.


[b]Collision Passes:[/b]

Removed faulty collisions on select terrain features.

Reduced unnecessary collision complexity on dense grass regions, improving navigation and load efficiency.

Inventory Additions: Hunger and hydration systems are now reflected directly in the inventory UI. Relevant consumables show contextual tooltips for their effects.

Cliff Geometry Overhaul: Several cliff segments have been remodeled to better support traversal, improve visual cohesion, and reduce clipping.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

        Resolved an issue with overlapping audio playback due to queue misreads of sound length.

        Fixed scanner interaction prompts that would remain on screen when no longer valid (e.g., after looking away).

notes.title: NaturesAscendancy 1.0 – Full Release Now Available
notes.notes:
After a long and rewarding journey through development, NaturesAscendancy has officially launched into version 1.0. This marks not just a milestone in terms of polish and completeness, but a culmination of everything the game has grown to become — an exploration-driven survival experience grounded in atmosphere, narrative depth, and emergent discovery.
Key Features in the 1.0 Release:

🔹 Reworked Alien Structures
All major Architect structures have been overhauled with new visual elements, improved guidance via environmental clues, and updated logic that ties more directly into the world’s mystery. These changes better support the late-game arc and make each structure feel significant and earned.

🔹 Streamlined Progression Flow
Blueprint acquisition and core gameplay pacing have been adjusted to improve clarity and reduce ambiguity without relying on hand-holding. The game’s systems now do more to guide through exploration — with a revised scanning system, subtle world clues, and radio signal pickups that point toward story-relevant discoveries.

🔹 Expanded Narrative & Worldbuilding
More lifepods, PDA logs, and audio fragments have been added across the planet’s surface — including new storylines, field notes, distress messages, and ecological insights. These fragments help flesh out the planet's history, the fate of other crews, and the role of the Architects. You may even uncover a few lingering questions.

🔹 Onboarding & Tutorial Improvements
Players are taught core actions such as inventory management, basic survival, scanning, and reading logs via little texts in UI elements — but the world remains theirs to interpret.

🔹 Resource Distribution & Biome Balance
Various terrain types now contain a more consistent distribution of key survival materials, fixing edge cases where players could get stranded without energy or key components. Resource rarity has been rebalanced, and critical components now have a more readable environmental context.

🔹 Performance & Visual Updates
This release also includes technical and visual upgrades, such as:

    Improved LOD handling in dense zones (especially jungle regions)

    Enhanced weather effects including wind, fog, and surface storms

    Optimizations for CPU usage and better streaming of terrain and flora

NaturesAscendancy has been shaped by your feedback, suggestions, and shared discoveries — and version 1.0 is our way of closing the loop. Whether you're a returning player or stepping onto the planet for the first time, we hope you'll find a world worth getting lost in!

notes.title: Full story and performance
notes.notes:
We’re proud to announce that the full narrative experience of Nature’s Ascendancy is now live and playable. This marks a significant milestone in development: the entire core storyline, including all three ancient structures and the concluding sequences, is now complete and ready for players to explore.

This update brings not only the complete narrative arc but also major performance improvements. Nature’s Ascendancy now meets its framerate targets across all supported hardware configurations, ensuring a smoother and more stable experience for everyone.

With this milestone, we are entering the final phase of Early Access. Our focus will now shift toward refinement, polish, and preparing the game for its full release.

We want to thank our players and supporters who have been with us on this journey. Your feedback and enthusiasm have helped shape every step, and we’re excited for you to experience the full story we’ve been building toward.

This is the beginning of the end for Early Access—and the beginning of the complete Nature’s Ascendancy experience.

Stay tuned.

—The Development Team

notes.title: UPDATE LOG — v0.11.0 | Radio, progression and onboarding
notes.notes:
We're pushing another foundational update to the default branch as we continue to refine early-game experience and progression flow.

Added: The Radio System

 A new deployable radio unit has been added to the standard survival kit.
 It will automatically detect and tune into surviving UIN distress signals, personal logs, and atmospheric anomalies.
The radio will serve as a narrative and navigational anchor, offering optional guidance while maintaining the game’s environmental exploration focus.

Basic Tutorial (Early Game)

A short, non-intrusive tutorial has been implemented for new players.
Prompts will appear when interacting with core mechanics (pod exit, movement, collecting resources, opening inventory, reading logs, etc).
Designed to maintain immersion while clarifying essential gameplay elements.

Additional Improvements

Minor UI polish for log interactions.
Small tweaks to radio signal timing and scan accuracy.
Backend groundwork for future expansions and PDA upgrades.

notes.title: Nature’s Ascendancy – Update 9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Major Changes & Additions   
-  New Underwater Effects  – Enhanced visual clarity and depth perception underwater.  
-  New Alien Structure Layout (WIP)  – The  first structure  is being redesigned for better exploration flow.  
-  Improved Swimming Controls  – No more tank controls; movement is now  more intuitive  and fluid.

-  Increased Shadow Resolution  – Improves depth perception and environment detail.  
-  Music & Sound Enhancements :  
  -  New Underwater Music  – Dynamic ambient tracks for submerged areas.  
  -  New Low Energy Music  – Subtle audio cues for when resources run low.  
  -  Improved Music Dimming  – Smooth transitions when entering different environments.  

  Bug Fixes & Tweaks   
-  Fixed a major bug in the second alien structure  causing interaction issues.  
-  Fixed various alien puzzles  that were not behaving correctly.  
-  Removed leftover particle systems  that were causing  unnecessary performance drops.

notes.title: Update 8.19 – Technical Overhaul & Stability Improvements
notes.notes:
This update focuses entirely on technical enhancements, bringing significant improvements to performance, stability, and rendering. While no new content has been added, these changes lay the foundation for a smoother and more reliable experience.
Key Improvements

Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.4 – Enhanced optimization, improved rendering, and overall system stability.
    
Shadow Mapping Implemented – Resolves previous flickering issues, providing more consistent and realistic lighting.
   
Performance & Stability Enhancements –
        Optimized memory management and CPU utilization.
        Improved asset streaming to reduce stuttering.
        Multiple crash fixes, particularly for extended play sessions.
    
DirectX 11 Support – The game can now be launched in DX11 mode using the -dx11 launch flag.
    
Save System Overhaul –
        Fixed save file corruption affecting certain edge cases.
        Introduced save file validation to prevent corruption before it occurs.
    
Reworked Modding API – Optimized for better performance and improved extensibility.
 
Material Adjustments – Removed problematic materials that previously caused lighting inconsistencies.

A Necessary Overhaul

While this update does not introduce new gameplay content, it represents a major step forward in technical stability and performance. The time invested in these improvements ensures a more polished and reliable experience moving forward.

notes.title: NaturesAscendancy 0.7 - Update Notes
notes.notes:
New Features:

The creature system has been optimized for smoother performance, now designed to work efficiently with systems containing 16GB of RAM. While the old scaling system still applies, it has been modified to prioritize 16GB setups, ensuring the game consumes fewer resources from other applications. This will result in performance improvements in other applications while running the game but not necessarily within the game itself.

Base Building System (Rudimentary):
A rudimentary base building system has been introduced, allowing players to construct and customize basic structures in-game. This is the first step in building a more expansive system in future updates. Players can now activate the Foundation Core, place living compartments, and craft new items to aid in survival and exploration. Expect more improvements and additions to this system in upcoming patches.

New Crash Site:
A new crash site has been added, filled with mysteries, hidden resources, and challenges. It serves as the perfect setting for players to test their new base building abilities and uncover further secrets of the alien world.

Bug Fixes & Improvements:

Save File Corruption Prevention:
Save file corruption that caused crashes in previous versions has been addressed. We’ve introduced new error-handling mechanisms to prevent faulty data from being saved, reducing the likelihood of crashes during save/load operations. We recommend saving and loading frequently to help mitigate any edge-case issues.

Creature System Bug Fixes:
Fixed several bugs related to creature spawning, AI behavior, and interaction with the environment. Creatures should now appear and behave more predictably during gameplay.

notes.title: Update Notes: Modding, new biome and polish
notes.notes:
New Content:
New Biome: A brand-new biome has been added, expanding the world and offering new environments to explore. Look out for unique terrain features and challenges!

Modding Support:
Proof of Concept Modding API: The first iteration of our modding API is now live! Currently, it supports item name modifications, allowing modders to start customizing the world with their own creations. More modding features will come in future updates!

Stability & Tweaks:
Stability Improvements: Several tweaks have been made to improve the stability of the game. Crashes and performance issues should be reduced.

Visual & Gameplay Adjustments:
Alien Structures: Minor changes have been made to the alien structures, improving their aesthetic and making them more immersive within the game world.

Animal Redesigns: Some animals have received a fresh redesign, giving them a more polished and varied appearance. Expect some exciting new models!

notes.title: Stability Update: Crashes Resolved
notes.notes:
We can now gladly let you know that we finally squashed those annoying crashes that had affected some of our players. Thanks for your detailed reports and the patience; after finding out the source, we took all needed for granting smoother and stabler play from now on.

If you have refunded the game due to instability before today's fix, we want to make it right. Just send an email to our support over at nexthorizongamescontact@gmail.com and we will provide you with a free copy of the game for your support and understanding.

Your feedback has gone a long way in helping us refine NaturesAscendancy, and we're committed to keeping this journey as seamless as possible. If you come across other issues, don't be afraid to reach out to us-we listen at any time.

Thanks for bearing with us through this remarkable journey. More updates shall follow, and always happy exploring!

notes.title: Alien structures and balancing
notes.notes:
What's New

    High Effect: Eating mushrooms now causes a high effect—visual distortions and unique audio to add immersion (and confusion).

Improvements

Bug Fixes

    Fixed numerous typos throughout the game.
    Resolved a crash when interacting with alien terminals in specific regions.
    Improved collision detection for some props.
    Fixed issues with audio logs cutting off prematurely.

notes.title: HLOD and performance boosts
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce a significant performance increase with the latest update to NaturesAscendancy! The game now includes HLOD and is ready to try out.
New in this version:

HLOD System: This new feature enhances performance by dynamically adjusting the level of detail for far-away objects, reducing unnecessary strain on your system while maintaining close-up visual quality.
Performance Improvements: Smoother gameplay with optimized rendering, especially in large and expansive areas.

notes.title: Performance & Rebalancing Update
notes.notes:
Performance Improvements

    Optimized resource loading to reduce stuttering when transitioning between biomes.
    Improved rendering performance for underwater environments, leading to more stable frame rates.
    Reduced memory usage for active environmental effects (e.g., radiation zones, weather).

Rebalancing Adjustments

    Slightly adjusted crafting times for early-game items to streamline progression.
    Rebalanced resource spawn rates to improve consistency in gathering (especially Lead and Biological Fibers).
    Increased durability of basic tools to reduce the frequency of early repairs.

Bug Fixes

    Fixed an issue where environmental hazards were not correctly damaging the player under certain conditions.
    Resolved a rare bug causing crafted items to disappear when inventory was full.
    Addressed inconsistencies with the Rad Suit's protective properties in high-radiation zones.

notes.title: New Quality of Life Features
notes.notes:
In response to player feedback, we've just added some highly-requested quality-of-life improvements in today’s update:

Custom Keybinds: You can now customize your controls, making your gameplay experience more comfortable and tailored to your preferences. Say goodbye to default layouts and hello to personalized controls!

Mouse Sensitivity Slider: Adjust the sensitivity of your mouse for smoother and more precise aiming and movement, perfect for those who prefer more control or need fine-tuned sensitivity.

notes.title: Progression Update - 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Underwater Crafting Progression: The new Rad Suit is now available, which will allow you to navigate through radiation zones. To craft the suit, you'll need Lead (found in deep water) and Biological Fiber (harvested from seaweeds in shallower waters). This unlocks new areas for exploration and introduces underwater survival mechanics.

Increased Depth to Exploration: With the introduction of the Rad Suit, you can explore more challenging environments and push forward your crafting and exploration journey.

Minor Bug Fixes: We’ve also addressed some small bugs to ensure smoother gameplay.
